title: Manager sign-in sheet - real render
lede: Not hand-drawn. Both frames below are auth_sdk's real LoginScreen widget tree as the Manager shell composes it, rendered headlessly to PNG at 390 logical px / dpr 3 on an iPhone-class viewport, with every numbered point placed automatically from the widget's own measured rect.

notes.kicker: note - how these renders were produced
body: A widget-test harness (test/render/render_screen_test.dart); zero app code touched. It pumps auth_sdk's real LoginScreen inside the app's own ScreenUtilInit design size and AppStyle brightness seam, at 390 logical px / dpr 3 on an 844-tall phone frame with the sheet resting on the bottom edge the way AppHelpers.showCustomModalBottomSheet puts it, and captures the RepaintBoundary to PNG.

The data is the SDKs' own demo data, not fixtures written for this page. The test runs with --dart-define=IS_DEMO=true and calls the SDKs' DI registrations in composed-app order, so AuthSdkDependencies installs MockAuthRepository and CommsSdkDependencies installs MockSettingsRepository - the same demo fixtures a demo build of Manager serves. Every visible string resolves offline through base_sdk's BundledTranslations after the language is seeded exactly as tour/app.tour.yaml seeds it.

Real, not simulated: Inter loaded as the real font files google_fonts itself pins (assets/google_fonts/), the real MaterialIcons and Remix icon fonts, AppStyle light/dark tokens resolved by the real setBrightness seam, and auth_sdk's own platform guards resolved for Android so the quick-access row is the one a phone build draws.

notes.kicker: why the sign-in sheet, and not the POS or the order queue
body: Those were the first choices and they do not render from demo fixtures. Every manager-role screen in this shell (POS, order queue, order history, restaurant profile) lives in an SDK's templates/ tree and only exists as Dart after the composer installs it into lib/, and each one reads a manager-role facade - SellerOrdersRepository, PosProductsRepository, SellerShopRepository - that has NO isDemo branch: ManagerOrdersDependencies and ManagerMerchantsDependencies register the live HTTP repository unconditionally. Rendered headlessly they would show their empty/offline state, which is a frame about the network rather than about the design.

The sign-in sheet is the manager shell's genuine first screen, it is owned by an SDK that does have a demo path, and it renders fully populated with no backend. It is the proof that the pipeline runs end to end; widening coverage to the manager-role screens needs demo repositories in the commerce SDKs first.

notes.kicker: found by rendering (a drawing could not have caught these)
items: The phone field opens on +93 - Afghanistan. AppConstants.countryCodeISO is String.fromEnvironment('COUNTRY_ISO') and nothing in this repo or the shared workflows passes that define, so intl_phone_field falls back to the first entry in its own country list rather than to the seller's market.
The primary action reads a hardcoded English 'Login', not a translation key: it is the one string on the sheet that will not localise.

Two RenderFlex overflows are raised while the sheet lays out - 95px on the keep-logged-in / forgot-password row and 50px on the quick-access row. The settled 390px frame draws neither, so they are transient layout passes rather than shipped clipping, but the sheet is that close to its width budget.
Nothing headless can reach connectivity_plus, so the render also proves the sheet draws its normal state rather than an error one when the connectivity stream never starts.
